title: Linux_Coinminer_Investigation_a67
description: Investigate unusual CPU usage patterns on multiple hosts to identify the source of a coinminer malware.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The network has experienced unusual CPU usage patterns on multiple hosts. Your task is to investigate and identify the source of this activity.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content:
You have SSH access to the following hosts:
- miner-host (IP: 192.168.50.5)
- second-host (IP: 192.168.50.6)

Use the following credentials:
- Username: cyrano
- Password: cyrano

Enter 'start' to begin the investigation.
levels.local_content:
Local sandbox access is not required for this scenario. Use the following credentials:
- Username: cyrano
- Password: cyrano

Enter 'start' to begin the investigation.

levels.title: Investigate Suspicious Service
levels.content: Investigate the suspicious service running on miner-host that is consuming excessive CPU resources.
levels.solution: Check the systemd services and look for any unusual or unauthorized services. The service name is 'sys-monitor'.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Check the systemd services and look for any unusual or unauthorized services.

levels.title: Analyze Process
levels.content: Analyze the process responsible for the abnormal CPU usage on miner-host.
levels.solution: Use process monitoring tools to identify the process consuming the most CPU resources. The process name is '/usr/local/sbin/python'.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Use process monitoring tools to identify the process consuming the most CPU resources.

levels.title: Locate Executable File
levels.content: Locate the executable file associated with the suspicious activity on miner-host.
levels.solution: Investigate the file system for any unusual or recently modified executables. The file path is '/usr/local/sbin/python'.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Investigate the file system for any unusual or recently modified executables.
